purpose: Ten electricity grid operators' public fuel-mix dashboards for the hero job: public pages only, no login, no paywall. Each entry says which chart the numbers are read from, and where the operator publishes the same mix as data, so the snapshot can show vision's reading beside the published one.

rules: A page with a bot check, or one that needs more than an ordinary visit and a cookie banner, is excluded; we never work around bot protection.
A site whose robots.txt disallows the dashboard path is excluded.
The agent reads every number from the chart with vision, even where the page prints it as text. The page text or the published data is the check, shown beside the reading.
Each screenshot is cropped to the chart itself, without the operator logo or page chrome.
